comment.text: KMT2A R1264 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bladder tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: esophagusstomach; Head and neck tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: headandneck; Gastric tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.
